focused_scope.reason: Replace quadratic escaped-string decoding without changing JSON semantics; test large nested SQL envelopes, escapes, Unicode, malformed strings and exact loaded source; wire the focused check into the existing smoke entrypoint.

summary: The escaped-string accumulator preserves segments, escape mappings, Unicode conversion, parser indices, byte values and errors while avoiding repeated prefix copies. Exact-source and embedded focused checks passed; independent baseline parity and size scaling checks passed.

resolved_findings.problem: Extensionless WA_BIN set by scripts/test.sh failed fs.existsSync on Windows despite a valid wa.exe.
resolved_findings.resolution: Commit 1887a6a adds the existing wrapper's .exe fallback; independent extensionless embedded run passes 18 checks with 0 skipped.

limits: Focused routine review only; full release gate was not requested or run.
Baseline Unicode behavior, including acceptance of malformed surrogate pairs, is preserved; this patch is a performance correction, not a strict-Unicode change.
Measurements cover synthetic nested SQL envelopes on this machine. Production memory overhead and every caller's end-to-end behavior were not measured.
Chunk accumulation uses temporary table entries per escaped segment; larger transient table memory replaces repeated immutable prefix copies.
